audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-4 disagree with the packet chart AND with the page's own whys[].
audit.why: Packet is Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Yasuo, Yasuo and the whys[] read exactly that way — whys[1] 'still keep you from ever trading back', whys[2] 'shut down your engages', whys[3] 'stay his', whys[4] 'levels to a skill check'. Stored sides were Skill, Yasuo, Yasuo, Jayce for those four rows, so the chart rendered the opposite of its own explanations.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3, 4 flipped in both layers as one atomic group with ratings rescaled. whys[] already agree and need no rewrite.

audit.whatIsWrong: One sequencing cue and no cooldowns.
audit.why: Shock Blast / To the Skies! 16/14/12/10/8/6, Lightning Field / Hyper Charge 10s, Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate 20/18/16/14/12/10, stance swap 6s, Wind Wall 25s at rank 1 for 4s, Last Breath 70/50/30.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into spikes[0], spikes[1], early, mid, phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two stances are mixed up ('Hammer Q Acceleration Gate', 'Cannon Q To The Skies'), Wind Wall is presented as an answer to his whole kit, and 'Last Breath converts ANY knockup' is false.
audit.why: To the Skies! is the Hammer Q and Acceleration Gate is the Cannon E — the page swaps both. More importantly, only Cannon form is projectile-based: Wind Wall eats Shock Blast, but Hammer form's To the Skies! leap and Thundering Blow pass straight through it, which the mirror states too. A player who holds the wall expecting it to stop a Hammer all-in loses the trade. Thundering Blow knocks you BACK, not airborne, so it can never feed Last Breath — only your own two-stack Steel Tempest whirlwind does.
audit.corrected: Stance names fixed; Wind Wall scoped to Cannon form; Q2 whirlwind named as the only Last Breath setup.

audit.whatIsWrong: The stance-swap auto reset is never mentioned.
audit.why: His R swaps stance on a 6s cooldown, resets his attack, and the first attack in Cannon form reduces your Armor and MR — the swap animation is the burst tell, not the ability cast.

edits.before: Jayce is a nightmare early: Hammer Q Acceleration Gate speed-boost plus ranged Cannon Q To The Skies poke chunks you before you reach him, and his knockback E stops your Sweeping Blade engage cold.
edits.after: Jayce is a nightmare early: Shock Blast (Cannon Q) fired through Acceleration Gate (Cannon E) chunks you before you close, and Thundering Blow (Hammer E) knocks you back out of your engage.

edits.before: Jayce has no real ult spike (R just swaps stances), so once you hit 6 the lane starts to even — your R Last Breath all-in threat matters more than his level-6 does.
edits.after: His R only swaps stance on a 6s cooldown, but that swap resets his auto and the first Cannon hit shreds your resists — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.

edits.before: After your first item you flip it: Wind Wall eats his Cannon Q + E poke, and once you close with Sweeping Blade his squishy melee form folds to your crit and R.
edits.after: After your first item you flip it: Wind Wall eats Shock Blast outright, but it does nothing to Hammer form — once he swaps to melee, just fight him.

edits.before: Late game is firmly yours — Jayce is a lane bully who falls off, and a fed Yasuo with Wind Wall and R engage runs him over in every skirmish.
edits.after: Late game is firmly yours — Jayce is a lane bully who falls off, and a fed Yasuo with Wind Wall for the Cannon poke runs him over.

edits.before: Jayce dominates levels 1-2 and beyond: his Cannon form pokes you from a screen away and Acceleration Gate lets him kite your every approach. You can't trade back, so focus on last-hitting and dodging his Shock Blast. He wants to chunk you repeatedly and deny CS so you fall behind before your Wind Wall matters.
edits.after: Jayce dominates levels 1-5: Cannon form pokes from a screen away and Acceleration Gate lets him kite your every approach. Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 — that gap is your only window. Focus on last-hitting, and note Wind Wall answers Cannon form only; his Hammer abilities pass straight through it.

edits.before: Through 3-6 Jayce keeps poking, and his Hammer E knockback ruins your Sweeping Blade engages. This is skill-tested at 6 — hold Wind Wall for his big Cannon Q, weave Q stacks off minions, and wait. Once you have some items his advantage evaporates; don't feed the poke lane by forcing bad all-ins early.
edits.after: Through 3-6 Jayce keeps poking, and Thundering Blow (Hammer E, 20s at rank 1) knocks you back out of your Sweeping Blade engages. Hold Wind Wall for Shock Blast, weave Q stacks off minions, and wait. Once you have items his advantage evaporates; don't force bad all-ins into the poke.

edits.before: From your first item onward the matchup is yours. Wind Wall shuts down his ranged burst and your E-R dive punishes his fragile frame — Jayce is a falloff bully and a fed Yasuo outscales him hard in every fight.
edits.after: From your first item onward the matchup is yours. Wind Wall shuts down his Cannon burst and your dive punishes his fragile frame — Jayce is a falloff bully and a fed Yasuo out-scales him in every fight.

edits.before: Save Wind Wall for his Cannon Q or the Shock Blast to negate his poke burst
edits.after: Save Wind Wall for Shock Blast — Hammer form goes straight through it

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Jayce's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Last Breath (70s at rank 1) fires only off your own Q2 whirlwind — Thundering Blow knocks you back, never up.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window — build your teamfight around that. Jayce carry threat: 8/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Last Breath needs an airborne target and only your own Q2 whirlwind supplies one. Jayce carry threat: 8/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he leads.

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — Projectile — Wind Wall blocks it! Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Jayce Shock Blast: 16s at rank 1 — a projectile, and Wind Wall blocks it. - Thundering Blow is 20s and knocks you back. - His R swaps stance every 6s and resets his auto; that is the burst tell.

edits.before: Projectile — Wind Wall blocks it! Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A projectile on 16s — Wind Wall blocks it. Hammer form it cannot touch.

notes: Stance confusion was systemic: 'Hammer Q Acceleration Gate' and 'Cannon Q To The Skies' both name the wrong form. suspectNames flagged 'To The Skies' as a near-miss spelling — the deeper error was that the ability belongs to the other stance entirely. UNVERIFIED and not asserted, matching the mirror: whether Wind Wall stops the Acceleration Gate deployment. The kit tags Jayce E as a projectile, which fits Thundering Blow poorly and the Gate not at all, so I scoped every wall claim to Shock Blast only.
